newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault Q1 sales 47.2 billion Ffr.
newsitem.headline: Renault Q1 sales 47.2 billion Ffr.

text.p: (All figures in millions of French francs)

Note - French carmaker Renault SA gave its consolidated revenue figures in a statement. It said revenues were up 3.03 percent from the year-ago period, or 1.8 percent on a like-for-like basis. Autombile division revenues were up 4.7 percent, or 2.7 percent on a like-for-like basis, and accounted for 80.2 percent of total group revenues.

"In the first quarter, the upturn in the automobile market in Western Europe, excluding France, was slightly higher than expected. In addition, there was a favourable trend in exchange rates. These items combined to offset the decline in the automobile market in France (down 26.5 percent in the first quarter of 1997), it said.
